```{r setup}
format_grades <- function(sheet_val, file_val = NA_character_) {
  if (!is.na(sheet_val) && sheet_val != "") {
    val <- tolower(trimws(as.character(sheet_val)))
    # "g3 & g5" / "g1,g2,g3" style
    m <- str_match_all(val, "g(\\d+)")[[1]]
    if (nrow(m) > 0) {
      nums <- sort(unique(as.integer(m[, 2])))
      return(paste(nums, collapse = ", "))
    }
    # "3,5" / "2,3,4" project-level style
    nums2 <- suppressWarnings(as.integer(unlist(str_split(val, "[,\\s&]+"))))
    nums2 <- sort(unique(nums2[!is.na(nums2)]))
    if (length(nums2) > 0) return(paste(nums2, collapse = ", "))
  }
  from_file <- grades_from_filename(file_val)
  if (!is.na(from_file) && from_file != "") {
    return(normalize_grades(from_file))
  }
  "—"
}

grades_from_filename <- function(text) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "" || text == "—") return(NA_character_)
  m <- str_match(text, "(?i)grades?[_ ]+([0-9]+(?:[,\\s]+[0-9]+)*)")
  if (!is.na(m[1, 2])) return(m[1, 2])
  m2 <- str_match_all(text, "(?i)grade[_ ]?(\\d+)")[[1]]
  if (nrow(m2) > 0) return(paste(m2[, 2], collapse = ", "))
  NA_character_
}

normalize_grades <- function(...) {
  vals <- list(...)
  vals <- vals[!vapply(vals, function(x) is.na(x) || x == "", logical(1))]
  if (length(vals) == 0) return("—")
  nums <- unique(sort(as.integer(unlist(str_split(paste(vals, collapse = " "), "[,\\s]+")))))
  nums <- nums[!is.na(nums)]
  if (length(nums) == 0) return("—")
  paste(nums, collapse = ", ")
}

grade_filter_label <- function(grade_num) {
  if (is.na(grade_num) || grade_num == "" || grade_num == "—") return("—")
  paste("Grade", trimws(as.character(grade_num)))
}

study_type_label <- function(val) {
  switch(val,
    cross_sectional = "Cross-sectional",
    school_panel    = "School panel",
    pupil_panel     = "Pupil panel",
    unknown         = "Unknown",
    ifelse(is.na(val) || val == "", "Unknown", val)
  )
}

clean_na_text <- function(x) {
  x <- trimws(as.character(x))
  ifelse(is.na(x) | x == "" | toupper(x) %in% c("NA", "N/A"), NA_character_, x)
}

# ── Read projects sheet (about-the-program) ───────────────────────────────────
projects_raw <- read_excel_sheet_any(EXCEL_PATH, c("about-the-program", "Project description"))
names(projects_raw) <- clean_header_names(names(projects_raw))

projects <- projects_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(country_iso) & country_iso != "") |>
  mutate(
    Country       = Country,
    ISO           = normalize_iso_code(country_iso),
    Project_Name  = clean_na_text(`Project Name`),
    Acronym       = clean_na_text(`Project Acronym`),
    Code          = str_pad(as.character(`Project Code`), 3, pad = "0"),
    Description   = clean_na_text(`Project Description`),
    Project_Grades = `Grade(s)`,
    Project_Languages = `Language(s)`,
    Study_Type    = `Study Type`,
    Study_Design  = `Study Design`,
    Assessment    = Assessment,
    Harmonised_ID = `2026 EGRA Harmonisation`,
    proj_key      = paste0(ISO, "_", Code),
    DataLumos     = datalumos_urls[proj_key]
  ) |>
  select(
    Country, ISO, Project_Name, Acronym, Code, Description, Project_Grades,
    Project_Languages, Study_Type, Study_Design, Assessment, Harmonised_ID,
    proj_key, DataLumos
  )

legacy_grades <- NULL

  legacy_raw <- tryCatch(
    read_excel_sheet_any(GRADES_PATH, c("assessment-surveys", "Study_rounds")),
    error = function(e) NULL
  )
  if (!is.null(legacy_raw)) {
    names(legacy_raw) <- clean_header_names(names(legacy_raw))
    grade_col <- names(legacy_raw)[grep("^grade", names(legacy_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
    proj_col  <- names(legacy_raw)[grep("^project", names(legacy_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
    round_col <- names(legacy_raw)[grep("^round", names(legacy_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
    year_col  <- names(legacy_raw)[grep("(data_collection_year|^year$)", names(legacy_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
    legacy_grades <- legacy_raw |>
      filter(!is.na(country_iso) & country_iso != "") |>
      transmute(
        ISO = normalize_iso_code(country_iso),
        Code = str_pad(as.character(.data[[proj_col]]), 3, pad = "0"),
        Round = as.character(.data[[round_col]]),
        Year = as.character(.data[[year_col]]),
        Source = str_trim(as.character(source)),
        Grade_legacy = .data[[grade_col]]
      )
  }
}

# Grades from catalogue external sheet (v1.1+)
catalogue_grades <- NULL
catalogue_grades_raw <- tryCatch(
  read_excel_sheet_any(EXCEL_PATH, c("assessment-surveys-external")),
  error = function(e) NULL
)
if (!is.null(catalogue_grades_raw)) {
  names(catalogue_grades_raw) <- clean_header_names(names(catalogue_grades_raw))
  g_col <- names(catalogue_grades_raw)[grep("^grade", names(catalogue_grades_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  p_col <- names(catalogue_grades_raw)[grep("^project", names(catalogue_grades_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  r_col <- names(catalogue_grades_raw)[grep("^round", names(catalogue_grades_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  y_col <- names(catalogue_grades_raw)[grep("(data_collection_year|^year$)", names(catalogue_grades_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  iso_col <- names(catalogue_grades_raw)[grep("country_iso", names(catalogue_grades_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
  if (!is.na(g_col) && !is.na(p_col) && !is.na(r_col) && !is.na(y_col) && !is.na(iso_col)) {
    catalogue_grades <- catalogue_grades_raw |>
      filter(!is.na(.data[[iso_col]]) & .data[[iso_col]] != "") |>
      transmute(
        ISO = normalize_iso_code(.data[[iso_col]]),
        Code = str_pad(as.character(.data[[p_col]]), 3, pad = "0"),
        Round = as.character(.data[[r_col]]),
        Year = as.character(.data[[y_col]]),
        Grade_catalogue = as.character(.data[[g_col]])
      ) |>
      filter(!is.na(Grade_catalogue) & Grade_catalogue != "") |>
      group_by(ISO, Code, Round, Year) |>
      summarise(Grade_catalogue = dplyr::first(Grade_catalogue), .groups = "drop")
  }
}

# ── Read study rounds sheet ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# v1.1 splits this into assessment-surveys-internal / -external; prefer internal
# (keeps Rwanda grade-specific and Uganda language-specific rows).

  EXCEL_PATH,
  c("assessment-surveys-internal", "assessment-surveys", "Study_rounds")
)
names(rounds_raw) <- clean_header_names(names(rounds_raw))

# Flexible column names across v1 / v1.1 sheet variants
proj_col  <- names(rounds_raw)[grep("^project", names(rounds_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
round_col <- names(rounds_raw)[grep("^round", names(rounds_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
year_col  <- names(rounds_raw)[grep("(data_collection_year|^year$)", names(rounds_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
lang_col  <- names(rounds_raw)[grep("^language", names(rounds_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
grade_col_rounds <- names(rounds_raw)[grep("^grade", names(rounds_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]
iso_col   <- names(rounds_raw)[grep("country_iso", names(rounds_raw), ignore.case = TRUE)][1]

rounds <- rounds_raw |>
  filter(!is.na(.data[[iso_col]]) & .data[[iso_col]] != "") |>
  mutate(
    ISO           = normalize_iso_code(.data[[iso_col]]),
    Code          = str_pad(as.character(.data[[proj_col]]), 3, pad = "0"),
    Round         = as.character(.data[[round_col]]),
    Year          = as.character(.data[[year_col]]),
    Svyset        = svyset,
    RCT           = svy_rct,
    DataFile_text = datafile_location,
    Codebook_text = codebook_location,
    Source        = str_trim(as.character(source)),
    Language_raw  = if (!is.na(lang_col)) .data[[lang_col]] else NA_character_,
    Grade_in_sheet = if (!is.na(grade_col_rounds)) as.character(.data[[grade_col_rounds]]) else NA_character_,
    Comments      = comments,
    proj_key      = paste0(ISO, "_", Code),
    across(c(RCT, Comments), ~ifelse(is.na(.) | . == "", "—", .)),
    Svyset        = ifelse(is.na(Svyset) | Svyset == "", "— not specified —", Svyset),
    DataFile_text = str_trim(ifelse(is.na(DataFile_text) | DataFile_text == "", "—", DataFile_text)),
    Codebook_text = str_trim(ifelse(is.na(Codebook_text) | Codebook_text == "", "—", Codebook_text)),
    DataFile_url  = datafile_urls[Source],
    Codebook_url  = codebook_urls[Source],
    Languages     = format_languages(Language_raw),
    # Grade hint from source keys like rwanda_2018_g2
    Grade_from_source = {
      m <- stringr::str_match(Source, "(?i)_g(\\d+)\\b")[, 2]
      ifelse(is.na(m), NA_character_, paste0("g", m))
    }
  )

# Attach legacy per-survey grades (match on ISO+Code+Round+Year+Source when possible)
if (!is.null(legacy_grades)) {
  rounds <- rounds |>
    left_join(
      legacy_grades,
      by = c("ISO", "Code", "Round", "Year", "Source")
    )
} else {
  rounds$Grade_legacy <- NA_character_
}

# Fall back: join without Source for rows still missing (e.g. blank source)
if (!is.null(legacy_grades)) {
  still_missing <- is.na(rounds$Grade_legacy) | rounds$Grade_legacy == ""
  if (any(still_missing)) {
    legacy_nosrc <- legacy_grades |>
      group_by(ISO, Code, Round, Year) |>
      summarise(Grade_legacy2 = dplyr::first(Grade_legacy), .groups = "drop")
    rounds <- rounds |>
      left_join(legacy_nosrc, by = c("ISO", "Code", "Round", "Year")) |>
      mutate(
        Grade_legacy = ifelse(
          is.na(Grade_legacy) | Grade_legacy == "",
          Grade_legacy2,
          Grade_legacy
        )
      ) |>
      select(-Grade_legacy2)
  }
}

# Catalogue external grades (v1.1), then in-sheet / source-key hints
if (!is.null(catalogue_grades)) {
  rounds <- rounds |>
    left_join(catalogue_grades, by = c("ISO", "Code", "Round", "Year"))
} else {
  rounds$Grade_catalogue <- NA_character_
}

rounds <- rounds |>
  mutate(
    Grade_legacy = dplyr::coalesce(
      na_if(Grade_legacy, ""),
      na_if(Grade_from_source, ""),
      na_if(Grade_in_sheet, ""),
      na_if(Grade_catalogue, "")
    )
  ) |>
  select(-Grade_from_source, -Grade_in_sheet, -Grade_catalogue)

file_mod     <- file.info(EXCEL_PATH)$mtime
last_updated <- format(file_mod, "%d %B %Y, %H:%M")

browse_base <- rounds |>
  mutate(round_ISO = ISO) |>
  select(-ISO) |>
  left_join(
    projects |>
      select(
        proj_key, Country, ISO, Project_Name, Acronym, Study_Type, Study_Design,
        Description, Sampling, DataLumos, Harmonised_ID, Assessment,
        Project_Grades, Project_Languages
      ),
    by = "proj_key"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    ISO = if_else(is.na(ISO) | ISO == "", round_ISO, ISO),
    Country = if_else(
      is.na(Country) | Country == "",
      dplyr::recode(round_ISO, !!!as.list(AF_ISO_COUNTRY)),
      Country
    ),
    Project_Name = if_else(
      is.na(Project_Name) | Project_Name == "",
      paste(Country, "assessment"),
      Project_Name
    ),
    Study_Name = if_else(
      !is.na(Acronym) & Acronym != "",
      paste0(Project_Name, " (", Acronym, ")"),
      Project_Name
    ),
    Study_Type = ifelse(is.na(Study_Type) | Study_Type == "", "unknown", Study_Type),
    Study_Type_Label = vapply(Study_Type, study_type_label, character(1)),
    Year = ifelse(is.na(Year) | Year == "" | Year == "`", "—", Year),
    # Prefer legacy per-survey grade; fall back to project Grade(s)
    Grades = {
      g <- mapply(format_grades, Grade_legacy, DataFile_text, USE.NAMES = FALSE)
      ifelse(
        g == "—" | is.na(g),
        vapply(Project_Grades, function(pg) format_grades(pg, NA_character_), character(1)),
        g
      )
    }
  ) |>
  select(-round_ISO)

browse_base <- browse_base |>
  mutate(
    base_slug = paste0(ifelse(is.na(Source) | Source == "", "survey", Source), "_", Code, "_r", Round)
  )

subtask_desc <- load_subtask_descriptions(EXCEL_PATH)
va_matrix    <- load_subtask_availability(EXCEL_PATH, subtask_desc)
linking_source <- load_linking_source(EXCEL_PATH)

browse_base <- assign_study_url_slugs(browse_base)
browse_base <- assign_survey_key(browse_base)
# Keep matrix_col alias for any leftover call sites
browse_base$matrix_col <- browse_base$survey_key
browse_base <- browse_base |>
  mutate(
    Subtasks = lapply(survey_key, function(sk) {
      study_present_labels(va_matrix, sk, subtask_desc)
    })
  )

# study_slug / Detail_url / country_slug contain "/" (URL paths); must not enter
# crosstalk data or reactable builds a broken crosstalkKey dict.
browse_sd_data <- browse_base |>
  dplyr::select(-dplyr::any_of(c("study_slug", "Detail_url", "country_slug")))

# Filter vocabularies from home-page sheet (display order)
country_levels <- if (length(home_meta$countries)) home_meta$countries else sort(unique(as.character(browse_sd_data$Country)))
year_levels <- if (length(home_meta$years)) as.character(home_meta$years) else sort(unique(as.character(browse_sd_data$Year)))
grade_levels <- if (length(home_meta$grades)) home_meta$grades else {
  paste("Grade", sort(unique(unlist(str_split(browse_base$Grades[browse_base$Grades != "—"], ",\\s*")))))
}
study_type_levels <- if (length(home_meta$study_types)) {
  unique(vapply(home_meta$study_types, study_type_label, character(1)))
} else {
  unique(as.character(browse_sd_data$Study_Type_Label))
}

browse_sd_data <- browse_sd_data |>
  mutate(
    Country = factor(as.character(Country), levels = unique(c(country_levels, setdiff(as.character(Country), country_levels)))),
    Year = factor(as.character(Year), levels = unique(c(year_levels, setdiff(as.character(Year), year_levels)))),
    Study_Type_Label = factor(
      as.character(Study_Type_Label),
      levels = unique(c(study_type_levels, setdiff(as.character(Study_Type_Label), study_type_levels)))
    ),
    Assessment = ifelse(
      is.na(Assessment) | Assessment == "" | toupper(trimws(as.character(Assessment))) %in% c("NA", "N/A"),
      "—",
      as.character(Assessment)
    ),
    Row_arrow = ""
  )

# Visible column order for reactable: Country, Year, Study Name, Grade(s), Assessment, arrow
vis_cols <- c("Country", "Year", "Study_Name", "Grades", "Assessment", "Row_arrow")
browse_sd_data <- browse_sd_data[, c(vis_cols, setdiff(names(browse_sd_data), vis_cols)), drop = FALSE]

browse_filter <- browse_sd_data |>
  mutate(
    Grade = if_else(
      Grades == "—",
      list("—"),
      as.list(lapply(str_split(Grades, ",\\s*"), function(v) vapply(v, grade_filter_label, character(1))))
    )
  ) |>
  unnest_longer(Grade, keep_empty = TRUE) |>
  mutate(
    Grade = ifelse(is.na(Grade), "—", as.character(Grade)),
    Grade = factor(Grade, levels = unique(c(grade_levels, setdiff(Grade, grade_levels))))
  )

browse_language_filter <- browse_sd_data |>
  mutate(
    Language = if_else(
      is.na(Language_raw) | Language_raw == "" | Languages == "—",
      list("—"),
      as.list(lapply(str_split(Languages, ",\\s*"), function(v) v[nzchar(v)]))
    )
  ) |>
  unnest_longer(Language, keep_empty = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Language = ifelse(is.na(Language) | Language == "", "—", as.character(Language)))

browse_subtask_filter <- browse_sd_data |>
  mutate(
    Subtask = if_else(
      lengths(Subtasks) == 0,
      list("—"),
      Subtasks
    )
  ) |>
  unnest_longer(Subtask, keep_empty = TRUE) |>
  mutate(Subtask = ifelse(is.na(Subtask) | Subtask == "", "—", as.character(Subtask)))

browse_sd <- SharedData$new(browse_sd_data, key = ~study_key, group = "af_studies")
browse_filter_sd <- SharedData$new(browse_filter, key = ~study_key, group = "af_studies")
browse_language_filter_sd <- SharedData$new(browse_language_filter, key = ~study_key, group = "af_studies")
browse_subtask_filter_sd <- SharedData$new(browse_subtask_filter, key = ~study_key, group = "af_studies")

AHEAD_TITLE     <- home_meta$heading %||% "AHEAD"
AHEAD_FULL_NAME <- home_meta$subheading %||% "African Harmonised Early-Grade Assessments Data"
AHEAD_FOOTER_LABEL <- paste0(AHEAD_TITLE, " \u2014 ", AHEAD_FULL_NAME)
AHEAD_DESCRIPTION <- home_meta$description %||% ""
AHEAD_N_COUNTRIES <- home_meta$n_countries %||% as.character(dplyr::n_distinct(browse_base$Country))
AHEAD_N_PROJECTS  <- home_meta$n_projects %||% as.character(nrow(projects))
AHEAD_N_SURVEYS   <- home_meta$n_surveys %||% as.character(nrow(browse_base))
AHEAD_N_PERSONS   <- home_meta$n_persons %||% "—"

n_countries <- dplyr::n_distinct(browse_base$Country)
n_projects  <- nrow(projects)
n_studies   <- nrow(browse_base)

# Build-time drift check against catalogue headline counts
if (!is.na(home_meta$n_countries_raw) && home_meta$n_countries_raw != n_countries) {
  warning(glue("home-page countries={home_meta$n_countries_raw} but loaded {n_countries}"), call. = FALSE)
}
if (!is.na(home_meta$n_projects_raw) && home_meta$n_projects_raw != n_projects) {
  warning(glue("home-page projects={home_meta$n_projects_raw} but loaded {n_projects}"), call. = FALSE)
}
if (!is.na(home_meta$n_surveys_raw) && home_meta$n_surveys_raw != n_studies) {
  warning(glue("home-page surveys={home_meta$n_surveys_raw} but loaded {n_studies}"), call. = FALSE)
}
```

```{r helpers}
# ── Reusable header style: force no-wrap at the colDef level ──────────────────
# This beats reactable's own inline styles, which CSS alone cannot override.
HDR_STYLE <- list(
  whiteSpace = "nowrap",
  overflow   = "visible"
)

# ── Badge ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
badge <- function(val, color_map) {
  if (is.na(val) || val == "" || val == "—")
    return(span("—", style = "color:#A0AEC0; font-size:11px;"))
  bg  <- color_map[[val]] %||% "#94A3B8"
  txt <- switch(val,
    cross_sectional = "Cross-sectional",
    school_panel    = "School panel",
    pupil_panel     = "Pupil panel",
    descriptive     = "Descriptive",
    pre_post        = "Pre/Post",
    rct             = "RCT",
    unknown         = "Unknown",
    val
  )
  span(txt, style = glue(
    "background:{bg}; color:#fff; font-size:10px; font-weight:600; ",
    "padding:2px 9px; border-radius:10px; letter-spacing:0.04em; ",
    "display:inline-block; line-height:1.7; white-space:nowrap;"
  ))
}

type_colors   <- list(cross_sectional = AF_NAVY, school_panel = "#7C3AED", pupil_panel = "#DB2777", unknown = "#94A3B8")
design_colors <- list(descriptive = "#10B981", pre_post = "#F59E0B", rct = "#EF4444", unknown = "#94A3B8")

# ── Truncated text with Read more toggle ───────────────────────────────────────
truncate_cell <- function(text, max_chars = 220) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "—" || nchar(text) <= max_chars)
    return(div(text, style = "font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; color:#374151;"))
  uid <- paste0("tc_", sample(1e7, 1))
  div(
    span(str_sub(text, 1, max_chars), style = "font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; color:#374151;"),
    span("…", id = paste0(uid, "_ell"), style = "color:#94A3B8;"),
    span(str_sub(text, max_chars + 1),
         id = paste0(uid, "_rest"),
         style = "display:none; font-size:12px; line-height:1.6; color:#374151;"),
    tags$a("Read more", href = "#",
           onclick = glue(
             "var r=document.getElementById('{uid}_rest');",
             "var e=document.getElementById('{uid}_ell');",
             "var a=this;",
             "if(r.style.display==='none'){{r.style.display='inline';e.style.display='none';a.textContent='Show less';}}",
             "else{{r.style.display='none';e.style.display='inline';a.textContent='Read more';}}",
             "return false;"
           ),
           style = paste0("font-size:11px; color:", AF_BLUE, "; margin-left:3px; text-decoration:none; font-weight:700;"))
  )
}

# ── Link pill: used for DataLumos, Data File, and Codebook ────────────────────
link_pill <- function(url, label, color = "#3B82F6", bg = "#EFF6FF", border = "#BFDBFE") {
  if (is.na(url) || url == "" || url == "—")
    return(span("—", style = "color:#A0AEC0; font-size:11px;"))
  tags$a(label, href = url, target = "_blank",
         style = glue(
           "font-size:11px; color:{color}; font-weight:600; text-decoration:none; ",
           "white-space:nowrap; padding:2px 7px; border:1px solid {border}; ",
           "border-radius:4px; background:{bg}; display:inline-block; line-height:1.6;"
         ))
}

# ── File cell: display filename + link pill on separate lines ─────────────────
file_cell <- function(text, url) {
  if (is.na(text) || text == "—")
    return(span("—", style = "color:#A0AEC0; font-size:12px;"))
  has_url <- !is.na(url) && url != ""
  div(
    div(text, style = "font-size:13px; color:#374151; word-break:break-word; margin-bottom:3px;"),
    if (has_url) link_pill(url, "Open on DataLumos ↗", "#0F1F38", "#F0F4FF", "#C7D7F5")
  )
}

country_flag_img <- function(iso) {
  if (is.na(iso) || iso == "") return(NULL)
  iso_lower <- tolower(substr(iso, 1, 2))
  tags$img(
    src = glue("https://flagcdn.com/w40/{iso_lower}.png"),
    alt = "",
    class = "af-country-flag",
    loading = "lazy"
  )
}

country_cell <- function(country, iso) {
  div(
    class = "af-country-cell",
    country_flag_img(iso),
    span(country)
  )
}

filter_accordion <- function(label, filter_id, shared, column) {
  div(
    class = "af-filter-panel",
    tags$button(
      type = "button",
      class = "af-filter-toggle",
      `aria-expanded` = "false",
      tags$span(class = "af-filter-icon", "+"),
      tags$span(class = "af-filter-name", label)
    ),
    div(
      class = "af-filter-body af-crosstalk",
      filter_checkbox(filter_id, NULL, shared, as.formula(paste0("~", column)))
    )
  )
}

row_arrow_icon <- function() {
  paste0(
    '<svg class="af-row-arrow-svg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" ',
    'width="22" height="22" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true">',
    '<path d="M4 12h13" stroke="#0049FF" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>',
    '<path d="M13 7l6 5-6 5" fill="#0049FF" stroke="#0049FF" ',
    'stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>',
    '</svg>'
  )
}
```

```{r table}
)

# reactable serializes slash-based row labels into crosstalkKey as a named dict;
# filters expect a plain vector keyed by study_key or the table will not render.

browse_table <- htmlwidgets::onRender(
  browse_table,
  "
  function(el, x) {
    function rowUrl(row) {
      var a = row.querySelector('a.af-study-link, a[href*=\"studies/\"]');
      if (a) return a.getAttribute('href') || '';
      return row.getAttribute('data-detail-url') || '';
    }
    function syncRowUrls() {
      var groups = el.querySelectorAll('.rt-tbody .rt-tr-group');
      groups.forEach(function(g) {
        var url = rowUrl(g);
        if (url) {
          g.style.cursor = 'pointer';
          g.setAttribute('data-detail-url', url);
        }
      });
      return groups.length > 0;
    }
    if (el.dataset.afStudyNav !== '1') {
      el.dataset.afStudyNav = '1';
      el.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
        var row = e.target.closest('.rt-tbody .rt-tr-group');
        if (!row) return;
        var url = rowUrl(row);
        if (!url) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        window.location.assign(url);
      });
    }
    var tries = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function() {
      syncRowUrls();
      if (el.querySelectorAll('.rt-tbody .rt-tr-group').length > 0 || ++tries > 50) clearInterval(timer);
    }, 100);
    if (typeof Reactable !== 'undefined' && Reactable.onStateChange) {
      Reactable.onStateChange('browse-table', syncRowUrls);
    }
  }
  "
)
```

```{r generate-study-pages}
  n_surveys = AHEAD_N_SURVEYS,
  n_persons = AHEAD_N_PERSONS,
  last_updated = last_updated,
  harmonised_data_url = HARMONISED_DATA_URL
)
```

```{=html}
/* Force every header's inner content div to not wrap */
.rt-th > div,

/* Full-width rows; columns pack left (Study name does not stretch) */
.rt-table {

<script>
function wireStudySearch() {
  var input = document.getElementById("af-study-search");
  if (!input || input.dataset.wired === "true") return false;
  if (typeof Reactable === "undefined") return false;
  input.dataset.wired = "true";
  input.addEventListener("input", function () {
    Reactable.setSearch("browse-table", input.value);
  });
  return true;
}

document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
  document.querySelectorAll(".af-filter-toggle").forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener("click", function () {
      var panel = btn.closest(".af-filter-panel");
      var open = panel.classList.toggle("open");
      btn.querySelector(".af-filter-icon").textContent = open ? "\u00d7" : "+";
      btn.setAttribute("aria-expanded", open ? "true" : "false");
    });
  });

  if (!wireStudySearch()) {
    var tries = 0;
    var timer = setInterval(function () {
      if (wireStudySearch() || ++tries > 50) clearInterval(timer);
    }, 100);
  }
});

if (window.HTMLWidgets) {
  HTMLWidgets.addPostRenderHandler(function (el) {
    if (el && el.id === "browse-table") wireStudySearch();
  });
}
</script>
```
